Usage: minds [options] [command]

Minds by Animoca Brands Builder CLI

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  --pretty                       Pretty-print JSON stdout
  --no-json                      Disable JSON envelope (debug)
  --builder-api-key <key>        Builder API key (overrides
                                 MINDS_BUILDER_API_KEY)
  --access-key <key>             Deprecated alias for --builder-api-key
  --quiet                        Suppress info diagnostics on stderr
  --no-color                     Disable ANSI colors on stderr
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]                 List Minds on your builder account (mindId +
                                 name for chat create)
  chat                           Conversation commands (list, show, create)
  send [options] <alias> [text]  Send a message to a conversation
  history [options] <alias>      Get message history for a conversation
  events [options] [alias]       Stream messaging events as NDJSON on stdout
  doctor                         Check api.build liveness, Builder API key, and
                                 messaging connectivity
  usage                          Cognition usage for a Mind
  cognition                      Cognition balance
  mind                           Mind account operations
  bazaar                         Bazaar catalog (public, no API key)
  circle                         Mind circle — list and manage human
                                 collaborators (not other Minds)
  help [command]                 display help for command

Usage: minds send [options] <alias> [text]

Send a message to a conversation

Options:
  --wait                Wait for a Mind reply via SSE/history
  --timeout <ms>        Wait timeout in milliseconds (default: "120000")
  --attachments <file>  JSON array of attachment objects
  -h, --help            display help for command

Examples:
  minds send main "Hello"
  echo "Hello" | minds send main -
  minds send main "Hi" --wait --timeout 120000
  minds send main "See attached" --attachments ./files.json

Usage: minds chat [options] [command]

Conversation commands (list, show, create)

Options:
  -h, --help              display help for command

Commands:
  list                    List conversations
  show [options] <alias>  Get conversation by alias
  create [options]        Create or ensure a conversation
  help [command]          display help for command

Examples:
  minds chat list
  minds chat show main --history-limit 5
  minds chat create --mind <mind-id> --alias main
